## Detailed Description
[BetaWidget](betawidget.md) sits between [AlphaWidget](alphawidget.md) and [GammaWidget](gammawidget.md) in the sorted catalog output, so the fixture verifies that ascending and descending orders differ on a predictable three-entry list.
